blocks.x: Cost and carbon as engineering metrics — unit economics, showback and green compute by design.

Cloud spend becomes rational when it becomes unit economics: cost per transaction, per customer, per model inference. We implement FinOps as an engineering discipline — tagging and allocation architecture, showback and chargeback per team, commitment strategies (reserved/spot mix) with utilization tracking, and architectural cost reviews where the expensive path is redesigned before it is deployed, not after the invoice.

Sustainability rides the same instrumentation: carbon telemetry per workload (compute, storage, network), scheduling flexibility for carbon-aware batch windows, right-sizing programs, and efficiency metrics per service. For sustainability-reporting clients we produce the data foundation for ESG disclosures — auditable, tagged and reproducible, aligned to GHG Protocol scope treatment for cloud.
